description: Family calendar & household hub. Public REST API + hosted MCP server for agents (events, tasks, lists, meals, members, activity).
rules: Auth is always a bearer `fam_live_…` API key created in the app under Settings → Integrations — there is no OAuth flow for Plannie's API or MCP server.
The REST API base URL is https://api.plannie.io/v1 — every request needs `Authorization: Bearer fam_live_…`.
The hosted MCP endpoint is `POST https://api.plannie.io/mcp` (streamable HTTP, stateless, no session) — point any MCP client at that URL plus the Bearer key, no install required.
The npm package for a local/stdio MCP server is `plannie-mcp` (unscoped) — NOT `@plannie/mcp`. `npx -y plannie-mcp` runs it; needs `PLANNIE_API_URL` and `PLANNIE_API_KEY` env vars.
There are exactly 16 MCP tools, covering events, tasks, lists, household members/activity, and meals/recipes — see mcp-tools.md for the full list and parameters.
API/MCP access requires the Plannie 'Premium + MCP' plan or an active trial (trials include API access automatically).
Errors are `{ "error": string, "statusCode": number }`; MCP tool errors carry that same message verbatim in the tool result's text.

`subscription_required` means the household's subscription lapsed; `api_plan_required` means the household is on base Premium without the API add-on; both are plan/billing states, not bugs to work around in client code.
